rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; data from 14 different studies and 25 different scan sites
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "We examined data for 1,465 HCs (54.47% male) and 1,294 cases, taken from 14 different studies and 25 different scan sites."

rci2_using_epd.detail: ABIDE I, ABIDE II, and TOP15 are listed among the datasets contributing HC train in Supplementary Table 1; ABIDE and TOP are confirmed EPDs
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange I (ABIDE I)"; "ABIDE II"; "TOP15"

rci3_epd_name.detail: ABIDE I and ABIDE II (both contribute to HC train across multiple sites); TOP15 (single site contributing 203 HC train participants)
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange I (ABIDE I)"; "ABIDE II"; "TOP15"

rci5_n.detail: Training phase HC; HBR normative model fitted separately for each of 1,032 brain regions using HC train
rci5_n.supporting_text: "we then trained a normative model based on hierarchical Bayesian regression (HBR), fitted separately in each region, in a training set comprising 1,196 HCs (55.02% male; Fig. 2a; HC train)"

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase; male percentage (55.02%) reported directly; male_n estimated as round(1196 × 0.5502) = 658; female_n estimated as 1196 − 658 = 538
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "a training set comprising 1,196 HCs (55.02% male; Fig. 2a; HC train)"

rci7_age.detail: Training phase; age range stated in main text; mean and SD not reported for HC train as a whole (Supplementary Table 1 provides per-site median and SD only, not suitable for direct pooling); age in years
rci7_age.supporting_text: "HC train spanned the age range of cases, enabling predictions for people aged between 18 and 64 years"
